tagline_en: Honey-soft foam that cleanses without stripping
tagline_zh: 细密小分子泡沫 · 双重氨基酸 · 保护皮脂膜
overview_en: A mild, gentle honey-textured cleansing gel with dense, soft foam that penetrates pores to lift dirt without over-cleansing, leaving skin soothed, hydrated and never tight or dry.
overview_zh: 精华蜜状洁面，绵密细腻泡沫，轻松深入毛孔，带走油脂污垢；洗后干净清爽，不拔干不紧绷，肌肤舒缓水润。
benefits_en: Maintains natural pH and reduces sebum
Protects and repairs the skin barrier
benefits_zh: 维持肌肤天然pH值并减少多余皮脂
claims_flagged: 多种天然成分…具有抗氧化、抗菌、抗炎的效果
